identity.name: Link Shield
identity.description: A high-precision cybersecurity scanning platform for professionals.

layout_strategies.scanner_layout: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh] max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-8

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_-5px_rgba(0,255,148,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 font-medium tracking-wide rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 border border-white/10 transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.outline: border border-primary/50 text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground transition-all rounded-md px-4 py-2

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm
cards.interactive: group relative overflow-hidden bg-card border border-border/50 hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl p-6
cards.neon_border: relative p-[1px] rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-primary/50 to-transparent

inputs.search_bar: bg-black/50 border border-border/50 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 w-full transition-all text-lg font-mono placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50
inputs.file_drop: border-2 border-dashed border-border hover:border-primary/50 bg-accent/5 hover:bg-accent/10 transition-all rounded-2xl p-12 text-center cursor-pointer group

badges.safe: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider
badges.malicious: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider
badges.suspicious: bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/20 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider
badges.neutral: bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-700 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay/blur

feature_threat_intel.alt: Hacker typing code in dark room

universal_guidelines: NEVER use gradients for text readability; ensure high contrast (WCAG AA).
ALWAYS use 'Space Grotesk' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
ALWAYS use 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data (IPs, hashes, code).
Use the 'Green (#00FF94)' color SPARINGLY for emphasis and success states.
Use the 'Red (#FF003D)' color only for critical threats/errors.
Dashboard cards must be uniform in height where possible (use h-full).
Inputs should look like terminal command lines or precision instruments.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette and font families.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create a reusable 'Card' component that supports the 'neon_border' variant.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the Layout wrapper with the 'hero_background' image and a dark overlay.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the Landing Page using the 'marketing_section' layout and 'stagger_container' animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Build the Dashboard using the 'bento_grid' layout.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Ensure all text contrast ratios meet accessibility standards on the dark background.
